test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
‘Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

The meeting will begin **by** 3 PM.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**by 3 PM**" is incorrect because "by" indicates a deadline or a point before which something will happen, not the exact time of an event.
 
• The preposition "**at**" is appropriate when referring to a specific time.
 
• The correct sentence should use "**at 3 PM**" to convey the exact starting time of the meeting.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The meeting will begin **at 3 PM.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **On:** Used with dates or specific days (e.g., "on Monday" or "on the 5th of October"). This is not suitable for referring to a specific time.
 
• **From:** Indicates the starting point of a period (e.g., "from 3 PM to 5 PM"). This is not applicable here because no end time is given.
 
• **Around:** Refers to an approximate time, which is not correct as the sentence specifies an exact time (3 PM).
